caveat: The pooled threshold was chosen descriptively using the same pooled OOF predictions being summarized. It demonstrates ranking/operating capacity, not an unbiased estimate of a future independently selected threshold. interval_caveat: Descriptive Wilson 95% binomial intervals. OOF predictions share training data; observations are not perfectly independent in the modeling sense. Not final population guarantees, and not proof that true error is below 3%.
